aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:ec461546-.title: AI Creative Strategist
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:ec461546-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:ec461546-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Gamma is growing fast, and paid acquisition is one of the biggest levers we have. The constraint isn't budget — it's creative. The companies winning in AI are testing hundreds of ads a month. Most teams ship a handful. You'll own the system that closes that gap. This is a build-and-operate role. You'll design and run the pipeline that takes a brief and produces production-ready static and video ads at a volume no traditional creative team can match, pairing AI generation with real editorial judgment and a real QA bar. You'll work closely with our media buyers and creative strategist to keep fresh creative in test around the clock, read the data to understand which ads moved CPA, and feed those learnings directly back into what you produce next. If you think production throughput is an engineering problem and you'd rather build the machine than hand-craft one perfect asset, this role was designed for you. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design. Every day. Own creative output for Gamma's highest-visibility moments, from product launches and brand campaigns to enterprise sales materials — set the quality bar by producing the work, not just approving it - Manage and elevate a distributed design team while collaborating with marketers on campaigns and brand initiatives. Hire new designers as the team grows - Drive AI-first creative production by building repeatable workflows for ideation, asset production, and iteration across your team - Own Gamma's brand identity and visual systems across every surface: marketing, social, events, and sales collateral to scale the brand from prosumer delight to B2B credibility - Develop creative strategies that serve Gamma's full audience spectrum, from individual creators to Fortune 100 decision-makers, adapting tone and visual approach while keeping the brand cohesive - Build frameworks that let regional teams produce on-brand work at speed, and lead localized creative for key markets across AMER, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC WHAT YOU'LL BRING - A performance or direct-response creative background with proof you've shipped high volumes of ad creative fast — this is a production and systems role, not brand or social - Hands-on fluency with AI creative tools across the stack: LLMs for copy and hooks, image creation, AI video, voiceover, and asset assembly - A builder's instinct: comfortable with prompt engineering, API integrations, and light scripting or automation (n8n, Make, or similar) to wire a pipeline together - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read creative and account performance in ad platforms and know which metric a given test is meant to move - Hands-on experience with both static and video formats, and the judgment to know when a rough static will outperform a produced video - Familiarity with subscription and LTV dynamics, so you're optimizing toward paying users, not just cheap clicks (Nice to have) COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $180K - $235K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:a7.title: Safety Specialist
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:a7.description: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations! DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations has been an industry leader in the design and supply of high-voltage, open-air substations, and switchyards since 1965. Over a half-century of building meaningful relationships with our customers and vendors boils down to one thing: people. We take pride in our collaborative approach where everything we do is designed to deliver the project the right way, your way. Though we have grown over the years, and now offer new innovations like our Factory-Built Substations, our age-old commitment will never change: to take care of you like family. DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations is currently looking for a Safety Coordinator to join their team. The Safety Coordinator is responsible for ensuring employees adhere to all safety policies and procedures, maintaining safety-related training records, and overseeing reports and inspection activities.
responsibilities: Promote and maintain a proactive safety culture throughout the facility and serve as a visible safety resource for all employees.

Conduct routine and daily observations of production, maintenance, material handling, yard, warehouse, and support activities to identify unsafe conditions, unsafe acts, and opportunities for improvement.
Exercise Stop Work Authority whenever an imminent danger, serious hazard, or uncontrolled risk is identified; communicate the concern, initiate appropriate controls, and document resolution.
Perform and/or coordinate formal safety inspections, behavioral observations, audits, job hazard analyses, risk assessments, and workplace exposure evaluations.
Lead the development, review, and continuous improvement of safety policies, procedures, programs, and work instructions.
Ensure safety procedures are practical, understood by employees, and implemented consistently across operations.

Investigate all recordable and potentially serious incidents, injuries, illnesses, near misses, property damage events, and other significant safety events; identify immediate, underlying, and root causes and establish corrective actions.
Track corrective and preventive actions to completion, verify effectiveness, and escalate overdue or ineffective actions to management.
Maintain OSHA-required injury and illness records and support required reporting, documentation, and record retention.
Support safety metrics and reporting, including leading and lagging indicators, incident trends, corrective-action status, inspection findings, and training completion.
Conduct new-employee safety orientation and recurring safety training; develop or update training materials based on identified hazards, incidents, regulatory changes, and operational needs.
Maintain accurate safety training records and verify that employees are qualified or authorized before performing safety-sensitive work.

Coordinate or support training and qualification programs for forklift operators, crane/rigging activities, PPE, Hazard Communication, lockout/tagout, emergency response, fall protection, electrical safety, fire prevention, hot work, heat stress, and other applicable topics.
Lead emergency response activities involving medical incidents, fire alarms, evacuations, hazardous material incidents, severe weather, spills, and other facility emergencies.
Coordinate emergency drills, evaluate drill performance, document deficiencies, and implement corrective actions.
Inspect and maintain records for fire extinguishers, AEDs, eyewash stations, emergency equipment, spill response equipment, first-aid supplies, and other emergency response resources.
Assist with development, implementation, and periodic review of Emergency Action Plans and other emergency response procedures.

Support industrial hygiene activities and exposure assessments involving noise, heat stress, welding fumes, dust, chemicals, lighting, ventilation, ergonomics, and other workplace exposures; coordinate outside resources when specialized testing is required.
Evaluate PPE requirements, assist with PPE selection, and maintain or support PPE assessments and programs appropriate to the hazards of each operation.

Assist operations with machine guarding, electrical safety, hazardous energy control/lockout-tagout, material handling, powered industrial trucks, cranes and lifting operations, welding/hot work, ergonomics, and other manufacturing hazards.
Review safety aspects of new equipment, process changes, facility modifications, and new or revised work practices before implementation when requested.
Participate in contractor and visitor safety activities, including orientation, site requirements, and verification of applicable safety documentation.
Coordinate with supervisors and managers to correct hazards while minimizing unnecessary disruption to production.
Participate in regulatory, insurance, customer, corporate, and internal safety audits/inspections; assist with responses and corrective-action documentation.
Monitor changes in applicable safety regulations, industry practices, and company requirements and recommend program updates as needed.
Serve as a liaison with Human Resources, Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Environmental, and other departments on safety-related issues.
Provide periodic safety reports and recommendations to the Safety Manager and facility management regarding trends, significant hazards, incidents, corrective actions, and program performance.
Support safety committee activities, toolbox talks, safety meetings, safety campaigns, and employee engagement initiatives.
Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling incident investigations, employee information, and other sensitive safety records.
Perform other duties as assigned by the Safety Manager or management.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0e5bf470-77b8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Services Engineer based in United Kingdom. You will serve as a key point of contact for users and customers, troubleshooting complex issues and coordinating their resolution. The position combines hands-on technical support with client communication, implementation work, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with IT, Product, and Engineering teams to resolve escalated incidents and improve service delivery. The role also contributes to stronger support processes, documentation, and knowledge management. Coordinate projects and assigned tasks while maintaining clear communication with customers and ensuring issues are followed through to resolution. Maintain accurate and detailed records of incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and workflows within the ticketing system. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of support processes, technical documentation, and knowledge-base resources. Ensure support activities comply with applicable healthcare regulatory requirements, internal IT policies, and established service procedures. Participate in on-call or varied-hour support schedules as required to maintain service continuity. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in IT support, technical services, or a related technical support environment. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven experience supporting IT environments, preferably within healthcare, clinical, or other mission-critical settings. Strong customer service and relationship-management skills, with experience handling user support or call-center interactions. Solid knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking, general computing, and technical troubleshooting principles. Hands-on experience supporting PC and server hardware platforms and working with command-line environments in Linux and Windows. Strong troubleshooting experience across complex applications, software products, and technical environments. Proficiency with Windows operating systems, including desktop and Windows Server environments, as well as Linux system administration. Familiarity with healthcare IT systems, including electronic medical records and clinical applications. Experience using ticketing systems and working within ITIL-based support processes. Knowledge of archival systems and storage media. Excellent diagnostic, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to identifying root causes. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3ed3057e-c684-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MEP Design Engineer based in Spain. As an MEP Design Engineer, you’ll contribute to the technical development of a major AI data center project with significant power and infrastructure requirements. You’ll take responsibility for designing and reviewing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems supporting critical infrastructure. Your work will directly influence reliability, energy efficiency, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance across the facility. You’ll collaborate with technology, IT infrastructure, suppliers, and engineering partners to integrate complex systems into a cohesive design. The role covers everything from electrical distribution and cooling to fire protection, ventilation, and building management systems. You’ll also contribute to technical specifications, tender processes, vendor evaluations, and the ongoing development of the Basis of Design. This is an opportunity to work on advanced infrastructure in a technically demanding, international, and fully remote environment. Develop and review electrical distribution systems , including medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, diesel generators, and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Design and review cooling and ventilation systems , including chillers, dry coolers, water towers, and liquid cooling solutions where applicable. Coordinate modular facility architecture and ensure effective integration with mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure. Develop gas fire suppression, ventilation, and OT/IT integration systems, including BMS and DCIM solutions. Review technical and design documentation provided by suppliers, contractors, and engineering partners, identifying risks, inconsistencies, and potential design gaps. Ensure MEP solutions comply with applicable regulatory, safety, reliability, and energy-efficiency requirements. Prepare, maintain, and update the Basis of Design and associated technical specifications. Participate in tender processes and evaluate technical proposals from vendors supplying generators, UPS systems, chillers, switchgear, and other critical equipment. Coordinate closely with IT Infrastructure teams to align power and cooling requirements with IT deployment needs. Support technical coordination throughout the project lifecycle and contribute to resolving design and integration challenges. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in MEP design for critical infrastructure or heavy-industry facilities, such as data centers, industrial plants, energy facilities, telecommunications infrastructure, or comparable environments. Demonstrated experience designing cooling and ventilation systems ; strong conventional HVAC experience is sufficient. Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems used in critical infrastructure environments. Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit , and relevant engineering calculation or design software. Ability to review multidisciplinary technical documentation and identify engineering risks, discrepancies, and integration issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical design solutions. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with suppliers, engineering partners, IT teams, and other stakeholders. English proficiency sufficient to work effectively with international teams and prepare or review technical project documentation. Experience with Tier III/IV facilities is an advantage. Knowledge of direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems or high-density computing environments is a plus. Familiarity with EU or Polish electrical, building, and fire safety regulations is desirable. jobgether-jobgether:lever:d7e90b65-5c45-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Provider Support Coordinator based in Canada. This is a full-time, remote opportunity supporting a growing network of therapists and clinicians delivering mental health care to older adults. You’ll serve as a trusted first point of contact, helping providers navigate day-to-day operational, technical, and patient-related needs. The role combines real-time problem-solving, relationship management, case follow-through, and proactive provider engagement. You’ll have a direct impact on provider satisfaction and on the ability of clinical teams to deliver consistent, high-quality care. As part of a startup environment, you’ll work with evolving processes and have the opportunity to create structure where it is needed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, empathetic, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership without constant direction. Typical hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET, with occasional flexibility beyond 6 p.m. when provider needs require it. Proactively engage providers: Regularly check in with members of the provider network, understand their needs, identify potential challenges, and look for ways to improve their experience. Deliver exceptional service: Represent the organization with warmth, professionalism, empathy, and a solutions-oriented approach, including when handling challenging conversations. Escalate appropriately: Use sound judgment to determine what can be resolved independently and what should be escalated to the appropriate team or lead. Improve processes: Help build and refine operational workflows as the organization grows, contributing ideas that make provider support more efficient, consistent, and scalable. Proactive and resourceful mindset: Comfortable working with incomplete information, identifying solutions independently, and creating structure in a fast-changing environment. Excellent judgment: Able to distinguish urgent matters from routine requests and determine when to take ownership versus when to escalate. Outstanding communication skills: Clear, professional, warm, and empathetic communication skills across email, phone, and other collaboration channels. Customer or provider support experience: Experience in customer service, operations, provider support, healthcare administration, or a comparable service-oriented environment is valuable. Problem-solving ability: Comfortable troubleshooting technical and operational issues and following problems through until resolution. Relationship-building skills: Able to establish trust and maintain positive working relationships with clinical professionals and other stakeholders. Adaptability: Comfortable in a startup or rapidly evolving environment where processes, priorities, and responsibilities may change as the organization scales. Ownership mentality: Reliable, self-directed, and accountable for completing tasks without requiring continuous supervision. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ddf2acc7-f484-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Security & Compliance Engineer based in Italy. This role combines hands-on product security engineering with cybersecurity compliance across connected hardware and cloud services. You will help build secure, resilient products while ensuring they meet evolving regulatory and cybersecurity requirements. Your work will span embedded devices, firmware, networking, software dependencies, and cloud services. You’ll conduct threat modeling, security validation, vulnerability assessments, and supply-chain risk management while translating findings into practical controls. The role also involves preparing technical evidence and documentation for product conformity and regulatory assessments. You’ll collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, cloud, product, external manufacturing, and certification teams in a distributed environment. It is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership at the intersection of product security, compliance, connected technology, and privacy. Own cybersecurity aspects of regulatory compliance for connected hardware products, including RED cybersecurity requirements and EN 18031. Support preparation for the EU Cyber Resilience Act, covering vulnerability management, security updates, Software Bills of Materials, support periods, and incident reporting. Create and maintain architecture and data-flow diagrams for connected products and associated services. Conduct threat modeling and translate identified risks into actionable security requirements, controls, and engineering priorities. Perform hands-on product security validation, including vulnerability and dependency scanning, SAST/DAST, software composition analysis, firmware analysis, network and service exposure assessments, and targeted penetration testing. Generate, maintain, and monitor SBOMs to identify and manage vulnerabilities within software dependencies. Validate security mechanisms including authentication, secure boot, and signed software or firmware updates. Translate security assessments and testing results into compliance evidence, technical documentation, risk assessments, conformity assessments, and Declarations of Conformity. Partner with hardware, firmware, cloud, and product engineering teams to embed security and compliance requirements early in the development lifecycle. Coordinate with external manufacturing partners and certification bodies while maintaining internal ownership of cybersecurity evidence. Collaborate with open-source communities and related projects to ensure security information, vulnerability handling, and software documentation are effectively maintained. Track product conformity status, security support periods, regulatory deadlines, and changes that may require reassessment. Provide privacy-by-design guidance for significant changes to cloud and software services when required. Requirements Strong hands-on technical experience in at least one security domain, such as embedded/firmware security, network security, application security, or cloud security. Experience creating architecture or data-flow diagrams and conducting threat modeling for real-world products or systems. Practical experience with security testing and tools, including vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, software composition analysis, SBOM tooling, network security testing, firmware analysis, or penetration testing. Experience working with connected products, IoT, embedded systems, firmware, or environments combining hardware, software, and cloud services. Demonstrated ability to translate technical security findings into structured documentation, evidence, risk assessments, and compliance requirements. Knowledge of product cybersecurity standards and regulations such as EN 18031, RED cybersecurity requirements, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, ETSI EN 303 645, IEC 62443, or comparable frameworks. ryzlabs-ryzlabs:lever:8becf06d-dd1a-4402.description: Remote, only for candidates in LATAM At Ryz Labs we are looking for a Billing & Refunds Coordinator to join our team. This is a hands-on role sitting at the intersection of finance operations, customer experience, and cross-functional process optimization. The Billing & Refunds Coordinator will own the daily execution of key transactional workflows—from managing collections and processing high-volume refunds to bookkeeping journal entries and directly supporting our most valued sellers and customers. This role requires someone who possesses financial precision and strong interpersonal skills. You are just as comfortable diving into Excel sheets, Stripe data, and ERP systems as you are translating complex payment or invoicing issues into clear, empathetic communication for our users. The right person has an analytical mindset, deep attention to detail, and a track record of thriving in fast-paced, digital marketplace or e-commerce environments. What You Will DoAddress Customer Experience support tickets related to payments, invoicing, and refunds. Monitor customer accounts and assist with the application of cash receipts, incoming Wire and ACH payments, and reconciliation of discrepancies. Preparing daily/monthly journal entries in the ERP system for Cash and A/R transactions. Processing Sales Team Requests, Refunds, Credits, Rate adjustments, and other one-off payment issues in Admin, Stripe and Avalara. Identify opportunities to streamline and enhance automation across key accounts payable and accounts receivable workflows, contributing to process efficiency and scalability, creating and updating accounting policy memos and process flowcharts. Sales Tax Exemption maintenance and refund processing in Avalara. • Serve as a point of contact for key sellers, delivering proactive updates on sales proceeds and payout schedules.What We Are Looking For • Bachelor’s degree or progress toward a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Customer Service or a related field preferred 4-6 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Bookkeeping, Customer Support or related finance support roles Familiarity with basic accounting principles and ERP systems (Stripe or Oracle Fusion experience preferred) Strong Excel skills and attention to detail in data entry and transaction processing Excellent communication and organizational skills Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environmentAbout RYZ Labs:RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:e7b1d85a-668f-4578.title: IT Service Desk Lead- Platform
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:e7b1d85a-668f-4578.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Ми шукаємо IT Service Desk Lead до команди SKELAR — екосистеми, що будує міжнародні IT-бізнеси з великими амбіціями. Це роль для лідера, який готовий взяти на себе команду HelpDesk та відповідальність за якість IT-сервісу для сотень користувачів у наших бізнесах. Твоя місія — зробити з хорошої підтримки системний сервіс: з прозорими процесами, метриками та автоматизацією, де технології допомагають бізнесу бігти швидко, а не створюють бар'єри. Ти керуватимеш командою HelpDesk-інженерів, відповідатимеш за розвиток ITSM-процесів та автоматизацію життєвого циклу співробітника (onboarding/offboarding). ТВОЇ КЛЮЧОВІ ЗОНИ ВІДПОВІДАЛЬНОСТІ: 1. People Management: - Команда HelpDesk (6 інженерів: Київ, Львів, Варшава): цілі та пріоритети, 1:1, мотивація, Performance Review, розвиток інженерів і участь у наймі — включно з досвідом ведення розподіленої команди. - Ескалації: бути фінальною точкою по складних кейсах підтримки та зберігати спокій у критичних ситуаціях. 2. IT Service Management (ITSM) та Процеси: - Розвиток культури сервісу: побудова прозорих процесів Incident, Request та Problem Management на базі Service Desk системи. - SLA & Metrics: розробка та контроль показників якості сервісу (FRT, resolution time, CSAT), аналітика ефективності команди та впровадження покращень на основі даних. - База знань і self-service: щоб типові питання вирішувались без тікета. 3. Автоматизація та AI: - JML-процеси (joiner–mover–leaver): автоматизація onboarding/offboarding через інтеграцію HRIS, IdP (Okta) та MDM (Jamf/Intune). - AI в сервісі: автоматизація рутини в тікетах, AI-асистенти для першої лінії, адопшн AI-інструментів у команді. 4. Endpoint та сервіси: - Google Workspace: впевнене адміністрування домену, аудит та автоматизація (GAM). - Device Management: парк техніки (переважно macOS) через MDM — Jamf/Intune, життєвий цикл, облік активів. - Закупівлі: техніка та ліцензії спільно з процюрментом. ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО: Досвід та Менеджмент: - Досвід на позиції Team Lead / Service Desk Manager / IT Support Lead від 2-х років. - Досвід управління командою підтримки від 3–4 фахівців: найм, розвиток, перформанс. - Досвід побудови або суттєвого покращення сервісних процесів: SLA, метрики, практичний досвід роботи з ITSM-системами. Технічна експертиза: - SaaS & Cloud: впевнене знання Google Workspace (адміністрування, безпека, аудит) та інструментів автоматизації (GAM/API). - Device Management: експертиза в macOS та досвід роботи з MDM-системами (Jamf Pro, Intune, Kandji). - Identity: практичний досвід роботи з IAM/SSO (Okta, Google Identity або аналог) на рівні адміністрування. - Автоматизація: звичка прибирати ручну рутину — скрипти, інтеграції, no-code або AI-інструменти. Soft Skills: - Service Mindset: ставлення до внутрішніх користувачів як до клієнтів — і вміння прищепити це команді. - Problem Solver: вміння зберігати спокій у критичних ситуаціях та знаходити ефективні рішення. - Communication: здатність пояснювати технічні речі бізнесу та давати команді чіткий контекст. БУДЕ ПЕРЕВАГОЮ: - Сертифікації ITIL, Okta Certified, Google Workspace Professional Admin, Jamf Certified. - Досвід написання скриптів (Python/Bash/Apps Script) для автоматизації рутин
